verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules are a fair question for a SaaS research notebook, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no user-defined rules or event triggers. The only nearby items are a one-off option to delay generations when AI limits run out, and built-in behavior such as notes automatically appearing in the Sources panel. Neither is a user-configurable rule that fires actions on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
